veranderings.voor: lê baie lande teen die see
veranderings.na: lê baie lande aan die see
veranderings.rede: A country lies 'aan die see' in idiomatic Afrikaans; 'teen die see' can read as 'against the sea'.

veranderings.blok: Zanzibar: eilande wat aan 'n land behoort
veranderings.rede: The bare noun 'See' as subject is unnatural; the definite article is needed.

veranderings.blok: Zanzibar: eilande wat aan 'n land behoort
veranderings.voor: maar nie altyd een is nie
veranderings.na: maar dit nie altyd is nie
veranderings.rede: 'een is nie' is a wooden reference; 'dit nie altyd is nie' is the natural form and gives the clause after the comma its own subject.

vlae.teks: Party lande word aan alle kante deur ander lande omring en het geen kus nie.
vlae.rede: Not a language fault, so not changed: the body says 'deur ander lande' (plural), while the decided definition of landgeslote uses 'deur land' because Lesotho is surrounded by one country, which the next sentence says. A person may want the body to match.
